title: On Getting the licence after three letters
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：get　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 get 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the elder ① got the licence after three letters before dawn, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② gets the licence after three letters in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ get the licence after three letters at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ got the licence after three letters before — a line in the memoir for November 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Getting the licence after three letters before dawn, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ get colder towards morning in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Get colder towards morning at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ gets colder towards morning before dawn every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ got the licence after three letters again when nobody else would.

⑩ To get the licence after three letters, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody gets the licence after three letters in public again and somebody must get the licence after three letters before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 得到（一般过去式 got the licence after three letters：1966 年长者头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 得到（一般现在 gets the licence after three letters：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 得到（不定式 to get the licence after three letters：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 得到（过去完成时 had got the licence after three letters：1960 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 得到（动名词 getting the licence after three letters 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 变得（get colder towards morning：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去变得天亮前变得更冷）
G. v. 变得（get colder towards morning：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 得到（后段两处：新来的后生照例 gets colder towards morning，而母亲又一次 got the licence after three letters）

answers.why: get 意为“得到”，1966 年长者天没亮就得到三封信后拿到那张执照，那是村子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 got。
get 意为“得到”，自那以后长者当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 gets。
get 意为“得到”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯得到三封信后拿到那张执照”，此处为不定式 to get the licence after three letters。
get 意为“得到”，回忆录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人得到过，故用过去完成时 had got。
get 意为“得到”，长者说“得到三封信后拿到那张执照这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 getting the licence after three letters 作主语。
get 意为“变得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去变得天亮前变得更冷”，should ever 之后用原形 get colder towards morning。
get 意为“变得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻变得天亮前变得更冷（get colder towards morning at once），以后再也不要提起。
get 意为“得到”，新来的后生每个年头都照例变得天亮前变得更冷，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 gets。
get 意为“得到”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就得到三封信后拿到那张执照，用一般过去式 got 叙述。
get 意为“得到”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要得到三封信后拿到那张执照，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和村子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 get 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the elder got the licence after three letters before dawn, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder gets the licence after three letters in public whenever the village asks.
Getting the licence after three letters before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever get colder towards morning in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village gets colder towards morning before dawn every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother got the licence after three letters again, and the village remembered that half.
